name: HP AGREEMENT PREVIEW
script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")

if not docname:
    frappe.throw("Loan Application is required")

doc = frappe.get_doc("Loan Application", docname)

# Generate the REAL agreement from Print Format

# Explicit API response

name: HP AGREEMENT CUSTOMER SIGN
script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")
rowname = frappe.form_dict.get("rowname")
signature = frappe.form_dict.get("signature")
signature_file = frappe.form_dict.get("signature_file")

if not docname:
    frappe.throw("Loan Application is required")

if not rowname:
    frappe.throw("Customer Agreement row is required")

if not signature and not signature_file:
    frappe.throw("Customer signature is required")


signed_on = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
signed_date = frappe.utils.getdate(signed_on)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save signature on Loan Application
# This is what the HP Print Format ultimately needs.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Application",
    docname,
    {
        "custom_applicant_signature": signature or "",
        "custom_flexi_hirer_signature_date": signed_date
    }
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save signing/audit values on Customer Agreement row
# ------------------------------------------------------------

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    rowname,
    {
        "customer_viewed": 1,
        "customer_acknowledged": 1,
        "customer_acknowledged_on": signed_on,
        "customer_signature": signature or "",
        "customer_signature_file": signature_file or "",
        "customer_signed_on": signed_on,
        "status": "Customer Signed"
    }
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Reload Loan Application AFTER saving signature
# ------------------------------------------------------------

doc = frappe.get_doc(
    "Loan Application",
    docname
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Runtime aliases expected by existing HP Print Format
# ------------------------------------------------------------

doc.hp_account_no = (
    doc.custom_flexi_hp_account_number
    or doc.name
)

doc.hp_reference_no = (
    doc.custom_flexi_quotation_number
    or ""
)

doc.hirer_signature = (
    doc.custom_applicant_signature
    or ""
)

doc.hirer_signature_date = (
    doc.custom_flexi_hirer_signature_date
    or None
)

doc.company_representative_name = (
    doc.custom_flexi_company_representative_name
    or ""
)

doc.company_representative_signature = (
    doc.custom_flexi_company_representative_signature
    or ""
)

doc.company_representative_date = (
    doc.custom_flexi_company_representative_date
    or None
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Company registered office
# ------------------------------------------------------------

company_addresses = frappe.get_all(
    "Address",
    filters={
        "is_your_company_address": 1
    },
    fields=[
        "address_line1",
        "address_line2",
        "city",
        "state",
        "country"
    ],
    limit_page_length=1
)

address_parts = []

if company_addresses:

    address = company_addresses[0]

    if address.get("address_line1"):
        address_parts.append(address.get("address_line1"))

    if address.get("address_line2"):
        address_parts.append(address.get("address_line2"))

    if address.get("city"):
        address_parts.append(address.get("city"))

    if address.get("state"):
        address_parts.append(address.get("state"))

    if address.get("country"):
        address_parts.append(address.get("country"))

doc.company_registered_office = ", ".join(
    address_parts
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Regenerate agreement AFTER signature is saved
# ------------------------------------------------------------

html = frappe.get_print(
    "Loan Application",
    doc.name,
    print_format="Hire Purchase Agreement",
    doc=doc
)


# Freeze newly rendered signed version
frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    rowname,
    {
        "generated_html": html,
        "generated_on": signed_on
    }
)

frappe.db.commit()


frappe.response["message"] = {
    "status": "Customer Signed",
    "html": html
}

name: HP AGREEMENT DIRECTOR SIGN
script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")
rowname = frappe.form_dict.get("rowname")

director_name = (
    frappe.form_dict.get("director_name")
    or ""
)

director_signature = (
    frappe.form_dict.get("director_signature")
    or ""
)

director_signature_file = (
    frappe.form_dict.get("director_signature_file")
    or ""
)


if not docname:
    frappe.throw("Loan Application is required")

if not rowname:
    frappe.throw("Agreement row is required")

if not director_name:
    frappe.throw("Director / Manager name is required")


signature_value = (
    director_signature
    or director_signature_file
    or ""
)


if not signature_value:
    frappe.throw("Director signature is required")


signed_on = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
signed_date = frappe.utils.getdate(signed_on)


# ============================================================
# LOAD AGREEMENT
# ============================================================

agreement = frappe.get_doc(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    rowname
)


if not agreement.customer_signature:
    frappe.throw(
        "Customer signature is missing. Customer must sign first."
    )


# ============================================================
# SAVE DIRECTOR DETAILS TO LOAN APPLICATION
# ============================================================

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Application",
    docname,
    {
        "custom_flexi_company_representative_name":
            director_name,

        "custom_flexi_company_representative_signature":
            signature_value,

        "custom_flexi_company_representative_date":
            signed_date
    }
)


# ============================================================
# SAVE DIRECTOR DETAILS TO AGREEMENT
# ============================================================

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    rowname,
    {
        "director_name":
            director_name,

        "director_signature":
            signature_value,

        "director_signed_on":
            signed_on,

        "status":
            "Director Signed"
    }
)


# ============================================================
# RELOAD LOAN APPLICATION
# ============================================================

doc = frappe.get_doc(
    "Loan Application",
    docname
)


# ============================================================
# VALUES REQUIRED BY PRINT FORMAT
# ============================================================

doc.hp_account_no = (
    doc.custom_flexi_hp_account_number
    or doc.name
)

doc.hp_reference_no = (
    doc.custom_flexi_quotation_number
    or ""
)

doc.hirer_signature = (
    doc.custom_applicant_signature
    or agreement.customer_signature
    or ""
)

doc.hirer_signature_date = (
    doc.custom_flexi_hirer_signature_date
    or agreement.customer_signed_on
)

doc.company_representative_name = (
    director_name
)

doc.company_representative_signature = (
    signature_value
)

doc.company_representative_date = (
    signed_date
)


# ============================================================
# RENDER FINAL AGREEMENT
#
# This contains BOTH:
# customer signature
# director signature
# ============================================================

html = frappe.get_print(
    "Loan Application",
    doc.name,
    print_format="Hire Purchase Agreement",
    doc=doc
)


if not html:
    frappe.throw(
        "Final signed agreement could not be rendered."
    )


# ============================================================
# CREATE FINAL SIGNED HTML ATTACHMENT
#
# wkhtmltopdf is unavailable on this server,
# therefore we intentionally store the exact signed HTML.
# ============================================================

file_name = (
    doc.name
    + "-Hire-Purchase-Agreement-Signed.html"
)


file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
    "doctype":
        "File",

    "file_name":
        file_name,

    "content":
        html,

    "is_private":
        1,

    "attached_to_doctype":
        "Loan Application",

    "attached_to_name":
        doc.name
})


file_doc.insert(
    ignore_permissions=True
)


file_url = (
    file_doc.file_url
)


if not file_url:
    frappe.throw(
        "Final signed agreement attachment could not be created."
    )


# ============================================================
# COMPLETE CUSTOMER AGREEMENT
# ============================================================

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    rowname,
    {
        "generated_html":
            html,

        "final_signed_file":
            file_url,

        "director_signed_on":
            signed_on,

        "completed_on":
            signed_on,

        "status":
            "Completed"
    }
)


# ============================================================
# ADD / UPDATE LOAN APPLICATION DOCUMENTS TABLE
# ============================================================

loan = frappe.get_doc(
    "Loan Application",
    docname
)


document_row = None


for d in loan.documents:

    if (
        d.document_template == "LDT-00001"
        or d.document_code == "HP-AGREEMENT"
    ):
        document_row = d
        break


if not document_row:

    document_row = loan.append(
        "documents",
        {}
    )


document_row.document_type = (
    "Hire Purchase Agreement"
)

document_row.file = (
    file_url
)

document_row.document_template = (
    "LDT-00001"
)

document_row.document_code = (
    "HP-AGREEMENT"
)

document_row.version = (
    agreement.version or 1
)

document_row.status = (
    "Completed"
)

document_row.generated_on = (
    agreement.generated_on
    or signed_on
)

document_row.customer_viewed_on = (
    agreement.customer_viewed_on
)

document_row.customer_signed_on = (
    agreement.customer_signed_on
)

document_row.director_signed_on = (
    signed_on
)

document_row.final_signed_file = (
    file_url
)


loan.save(
    ignore_permissions=True
)


frappe.db.commit()


frappe.response["message"] = {
    "status":
        "Completed",

    "html":
        html,

    "file_url":
        file_url
}

name: Flexi Create Customer From Loan Application
script:
if doc.applicant_type == 'Customer' and not doc.applicant:
    existing_customer = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", {"custom_tin_number": doc.custom_tin_number}, "name") if doc.custom_tin_number else None
    if existing_customer:
        doc.applicant = existing_customer
    else:
            customer = frappe.new_doc('Customer')
            customer.customer_name = doc.applicant_name
            customer.type = 'Company'
            customer.mobile_number = doc.applicant_phone_number
            customer.email_address = doc.applicant_email_address
            customer.custom_tin_number = doc.custom_tin_number
            customer.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            contact = frappe.new_doc('Contact')
            contact.first_name = doc.applicant_name
            contact.append('email_ids', {'email_id': doc.applicant_email_address, 'is_primary': 1})
            contact.append('phone_nos', {'phone': doc.applicant_phone_number, 'is_primary_mobile_no': 1})
            contact.append('links', {'link_doctype': 'Customer', 'link_name': customer.name})
            contact.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            address_city = doc.city or doc.custom_new_city
            address_state = doc.state or doc.custom_province
            if address_city:
                doc.city = address_city
                doc.state = address_state
                address = frappe.new_doc('Address')
                address.address_type = 'Billing'
                address.address_line1 = doc.address_line_1
                address.address_line2 = doc.address_line_2
                address.city = address_city
                address.state = address_state
                address.country = doc.country or 'Fiji'
                address.pincode = doc.zip_code
                address.append('links', {'link_doctype': 'Customer', 'link_name': customer.name})
                address.save(ignore_permissions=True)
                customer.customer_primary_address = address.name
            customer.customer_primary_contact = contact.name
            customer.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            doc.applicant = customer.name

name: Calculations
script:
flt = frappe.utils.flt

def normalize_fiji_phone(value):
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    digits = "".join(character for character in value if character.isdigit())
    while digits.startswith("679679"):
        digits = digits[3:]
    if digits.startswith("679"):
        digits = digits[3:]
    return "+679-" + digits if len(digits) == 7 else value

if doc.docstatus == 1 and not doc.is_new():
    months = int(flt(doc.custom_flexi_term_months or 12))
    total_receivable = round(flt(doc.custom_flexi_total_receivable), 2)
    term_charges = round(flt(doc.custom_flexi_term_charges), 2)
    doc.repayment_periods = months
    doc.repayment_amount = round(total_receivable / months, 2) if months else 0
    doc.total_payable_amount = total_receivable
    doc.total_payable_interest = term_charges
else:
    if doc.applicant_type == "Customer" and doc.applicant and frappe.db.exists("Customer", doc.applicant):
        customer = frappe.get_doc("Customer", doc.applicant)
        if not customer.customer_name:
            frappe.throw("Customer Full Name is missing in the selected Customer master.")
        doc.custom_customer_full_name = customer.customer_name
        contact = frappe.get_doc("Contact", customer.customer_primary_contact) if customer.customer_primary_contact and frappe.db.exists("Contact", customer.customer_primary_contact) else None
        address = frappe.get_doc("Address", customer.customer_primary_address) if customer.customer_primary_address and frappe.db.exists("Address", customer.customer_primary_address) else None
        contact_has_split_name = bool(contact and (contact.middle_name or contact.last_name))
        full_name = contact.full_name if contact and contact.full_name else (customer.customer_name or "")
        parts = [part for part in full_name.split(" ") if part]
        first_name = contact.first_name if contact_has_split_name and contact.first_name else (parts[0] if parts else "")
        middle_name = contact.middle_name if contact_has_split_name and contact.middle_name else (" ".join(parts[1:-1]) if len(parts) > 2 else "")
        surname = contact.last_name if contact_has_split_name and contact.last_name else (parts[-1] if len(parts) > 1 else "")
        if not doc.custom_first_name:
            doc.custom_first_name = first_name
        if not doc.custom_middle_name:
            doc.custom_middle_name = middle_name
        if not doc.custom_surname:
            doc.custom_surname = surname
        if not doc.custom_tin_number:
            doc.custom_tin_number = customer.custom_tin_number
        if not doc.applicant_email_address:
            doc.applicant_email_address = customer.email_id
        if not doc.applicant_phone_number:
            doc.applicant_phone_number = customer.mobile_no
        if address:
            if not doc.address_line_1:
                doc.address_line_1 = address.address_line1
            if not doc.address_line_2:
                doc.address_line_2 = address.address_line2
            if not doc.custom_new_city:
                doc.custom_new_city = address.city
            if not doc.city:
                doc.city = address.city
            if not doc.custom_province:
                doc.custom_province = address.state
            if not doc.state:
                doc.state = address.state
            if not doc.country:
                doc.country = address.country or "Fiji"
            if not doc.zip_code:
                doc.zip_code = address.pincode

    name_parts = [doc.get("custom_first_name"), doc.get("custom_middle_name"), doc.get("custom_surname")]
    if any(name_parts):
        doc.applicant_name = " ".join(str(part).strip() for part in name_parts if part)
    for fieldname in ("applicant_phone_number", "custom_flexi_employer_contact", "custom_flexi_spouse_mobile", "custom_flexi_spouse_employer_contact"):
        if doc.get(fieldname):
            doc.set(fieldname, normalize_fiji_phone(doc.get(fieldname)))
    for contact in (doc.get("custom_flexi_application_contacts") or []):
        for fieldname in ("mobile_number", "home_phone", "employer_contact"):
            if contact.get(fieldname):
                contact.set(fieldname, normalize_fiji_phone(contact.get(fieldname)))

    flt = frappe.utils.flt

    def money(value):
        return round(frappe.utils.flt(value), 2)

    monthly_factors = {
        "Weekly": 52 / 12,
        "Fortnightly": 26 / 12,
        "Bi-monthly": 2,
        "Monthly": 1,
    }

    # Income, expenses, and existing obligations
    monthly_income = 0
    annual_salary_after_fnpf = 0
    annual_factors = {"Weekly": 52, "Fortnightly": 26, "Bi-monthly": 24, "Monthly": 12}
    assessment_frequency = "Monthly"
    for row in (doc.get("custom_flexi_income_entries") or []):
        exact_monthly = flt(row.amount) * monthly_factors.get(row.frequency, 1)
        row.monthly_amount = money(exact_monthly)
        monthly_income += abs(exact_monthly) if row.income_type == "Salary Deductions" else exact_monthly
        if row.income_type == "Net Salary / Wages":
            annual_salary_after_fnpf += flt(row.amount) * annual_factors.get(row.frequency, 12)
        if assessment_frequency == "Monthly" and row.frequency:
            assessment_frequency = row.frequency

    monthly_expenses = 0
    for row in (doc.get("custom_flexi_living_expenses") or []):
        exact_monthly = flt(row.expense_amount) * flt(row.frequency_per_month or 1)
        row.monthly_amount = money(exact_monthly)
        monthly_expenses += exact_monthly

    monthly_obligations = 0
    for row in (doc.get("custom_flexi_finance_obligations") or []):
        exact_monthly = flt(row.amount) * monthly_factors.get(row.frequency, 1)
        row.monthly_amount = money(exact_monthly)
        monthly_obligations += exact_monthly

    doc.custom_flexi_total_monthly_income = money(monthly_income)
    doc.custom_flexi_total_annual_income = money(monthly_income * 12)
    doc.custom_flexi_total_monthly_expenses = money(monthly_expenses)
    doc.custom_flexi_net_monthly_income = money(monthly_income - monthly_expenses)

    doc.custom_flexi_dsr_total_income = money(monthly_income)
    doc.custom_flexi_total_finance_obligations = money(monthly_obligations)
    doc.custom_flexi_dsr_net_income = money(monthly_income - monthly_obligations)
    doc.custom_flexi_annual_salary_after_fnpf = money(annual_salary_after_fnpf)

    pre_dsr = (monthly_obligations / monthly_income * 100) if monthly_income else 0
    max_dsr = flt(doc.custom_flexi_selected_dsr or 35)
    weeks_per_assessment_month = 52 / 12 if assessment_frequency in ("Weekly", "Fortnightly") else 4
    weekly_eligibility = max((monthly_income * max_dsr / 100 - monthly_obligations) / weeks_per_assessment_month, 0)

    doc.custom_flexi_pre_dsr = money(pre_dsr)
    doc.custom_flexi_regulatory_max_dsr = 50
    doc.custom_flexi_dsr_margin = money(max(max_dsr - pre_dsr, 0))
    doc.custom_flexi_weekly_eligibility = money(weekly_eligibility)
    doc.custom_flexi_max_hp_52_weeks = money(weekly_eligibility * 52)
    doc.custom_flexi_max_hp_78_weeks = money(weekly_eligibility * 78)
    doc.custom_flexi_max_hp_104_weeks = money(weekly_eligibility * 104)
    doc.custom_flexi_max_hp_156_weeks = money(weekly_eligibility * 156)

    # Purchase and finance summary
    purchase_value = 0
    for row in (doc.get("custom_flexi_purchase_items") or []):
        row.total_amount = money(flt(row.quantity or 0) * flt(row.unit_price or 0))
        purchase_value += row.total_amount

    # A quotation may be entered as a requested amount without item rows.
    purchase_value = purchase_value or flt(doc.custom_flexi_cash_price or doc.loan_amount)

    surcharge_rate = max(flt(doc.custom_flexi_surcharge_rate), 0)
    surcharge_amount = money(purchase_value * surcharge_rate / 100)
    deposit_amount = money(min(max(flt(doc.custom_flexi_deposit_amount), 0), purchase_value))
    deposit_percent = money(deposit_amount / purchase_value * 100) if purchase_value else 0
    value_after_deposit = money(max(purchase_value - deposit_amount, 0) + surcharge_amount)

    documentation_fee = flt(doc.custom_flexi_documentation_fee or 25)
    stamp_duty = flt(doc.custom_flexi_stamp_duty_fee)
    other_fee = flt(doc.custom_flexi_other_fee)

    # Use the configured field rather than hard-coding 2.5%.
    admin_fee_rate = flt(doc.custom_flexi_admin_fee_rate or 2.5)
    admin_fee = money(value_after_deposit * admin_fee_rate / 100)

    net_financed = money(
        value_after_deposit + documentation_fee + admin_fee + stamp_duty + other_fee
    ) if purchase_value else 0

    months = int(flt(doc.custom_flexi_term_months or 12))
    interest_rate = flt(doc.custom_flexi_interest_rate)
    term_charges = money(net_financed * interest_rate / 100 * months / 12)
    total_receivable = money(net_financed + term_charges)

    doc.custom_flexi_cash_price = money(purchase_value)
    doc.custom_flexi_deposit_amount = deposit_amount
    doc.custom_flexi_deposit_percent = deposit_percent
    doc.custom_flexi_value_after_deposit = value_after_deposit
    doc.custom_flexi_admin_fee = admin_fee
    doc.custom_flexi_net_amount_financed = net_financed
    doc.custom_flexi_term_charges = term_charges
    doc.custom_flexi_total_receivable = total_receivable
    doc.custom_flexi_surcharge_amount = surcharge_amount
    doc.custom_flexi_full_value = money(purchase_value + surcharge_amount)
    doc.custom_flexi_term_years = money(months / 12)

    # The application amount is derived from the supplied items.
    doc.loan_amount = value_after_deposit

    counts = {
        "weekly": round(months * 52 / 12),
        "fortnightly": round(months * 26 / 12),
        "bimonthly": months * 2,
        "monthly": months,
    }

    for period, count in counts.items():
        doc.set( "custom_flexi_%s_instalments" % period, count)
        doc.set(
            "custom_flexi_%s_instalment_amount" % period,
            money(total_receivable / count) if count else 0,
        )

    weekly_amount = total_receivable / counts["weekly"] if counts["weekly"] else 0
    fortnightly_amount = total_receivable / counts["fortnightly"] if counts["fortnightly"] else 0
    bimonthly_amount = total_receivable / counts["bimonthly"] if counts["bimonthly"] else 0
    monthly_amount = total_receivable / counts["monthly"] if counts["monthly"] else 0
    selected_monthly = {
        "Weekly": weekly_amount * 52 / 12,
        "Fortnightly": fortnightly_amount * 26 / 12,
        "Bi-monthly": bimonthly_amount * 2,
        "Monthly": monthly_amount,
    }.get(doc.custom_flexi_payment_period, monthly_amount)
    post_dsr = ((monthly_obligations + selected_monthly) / monthly_income * 100) if monthly_income else 0
    assessed = monthly_income > 0 and total_receivable > 0
    eligible = assessed and weekly_amount <= weekly_eligibility and post_dsr <= max_dsr
    doc.custom_flexi_post_dsr = money(post_dsr)
    doc.custom_flexi_eligibility_status = "Achieved" if eligible else ("Not Achieved" if assessed else "Not Assessed")

    # Keep standard ERPNext repayment fields in sync.
    doc.repayment_periods = counts["monthly"]
    doc.repayment_amount = money(total_receivable / counts["monthly"]) if counts["monthly"] else 0
    doc.total_payable_amount = total_receivable
    doc.total_payable_interest = term_charges

name: Flexi Flat Repayment Schedule Sync
script:
flt = frappe.utils.flt

if doc.loan and doc.repayment_frequency == "Monthly":
    loan_application = frappe.db.get_value("Loan", doc.loan, "loan_application")
    if loan_application:
        values = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Loan Application",
            loan_application,
            [
                "loan_amount",
                "custom_flexi_term_months",
                "custom_flexi_term_charges",
                "custom_flexi_total_receivable",
                "custom_flexi_monthly_instalment_amount",
            ],
            as_dict=True,
        )
        periods = int(flt(values.custom_flexi_term_months))
        rows = doc.get("repayment_schedule") or []
        if periods and len(rows) == periods and flt(values.custom_flexi_total_receivable):
            principal_total = round(flt(values.loan_amount), 2)
            interest_total = round(flt(values.custom_flexi_term_charges), 2)
            total_receivable = round(flt(values.custom_flexi_total_receivable), 2)
            charges_total = round(max(total_receivable - principal_total - interest_total, 0), 2)

            principal_each = round(principal_total / periods, 2)
            interest_each = round(interest_total / periods, 2)
            charges_each = round(charges_total / periods, 2)

            principal_used = 0
            interest_used = 0
            charges_used = 0
            balance = principal_total

            for index, row in enumerate(rows):
                if index == periods - 1:
                    principal = round(principal_total - principal_used, 2)
                    interest = round(interest_total - interest_used, 2)
                    charges = round(charges_total - charges_used, 2)
                else:
                    principal = principal_each
                    interest = interest_each
                    charges = charges_each

                principal_used += principal
                interest_used += interest
                charges_used += charges
                balance = round(max(balance - principal, 0), 2)

                row.principal_amount = principal
                row.interest_amount = interest
                row.charges = charges
                row.total_payment = round(principal + interest + charges, 2)
                row.balance_loan_amount = balance

            doc.monthly_repayment_amount = round(
                flt(values.custom_flexi_monthly_instalment_amount), 2
            )
            doc.repayment_schedule_type = "Flat Interest Rate"

        po.currency = "FJD"
        po.transaction_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
        po.schedule_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()

        if doc.get("applicant"):
            if doc.get("applicant_type") != "Customer":
                frappe.throw("PO applicant must be a Customer.")

                frappe.throw("Customer not found: " + doc.applicant)

            po.customer = doc.applicant
            po.customer_name = doc.get("applicant_name")

        po.remarks = (
            "Loan Application: " + doc.name
            + " | Loan: " + str(loan_name)
            + " | Customer: " + str(doc.get("applicant_name") or "")

            description = row.get("product_description") or ""
            qty = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("quantity"))
            rate = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("unit_price"))

            if not description.strip():
                frappe.throw(
                    "Enter product description in HP row " + str(row.idx)
                )

            if qty <= 0:
                frappe.throw(
                    "Quantity must be greater than zero in HP row "
                    + str(row.idx)
                )

            po.append("items", {

                "item_name": "General",

                "rate": rate,
                "uom": "Unit",
                "stock_uom": "Unit",
                "conversion_factor": 1,
                "schedule_date": po.schedule_date
            })

        po.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        frappe.msgprint(
            "Draft Purchase Order " + po.name + " created.",
            title="LPO Generated",
            indicator="green"
        )

    })

    if not existing_po:

            "Loan",
            {"loan_application": doc.name},
            "name"
        ) or ""

        po = frappe.new_doc("Purchase Order")
        po.supplier = "Comfort Home Distribution PTE Limited"
        po.company = doc.company or "Comfort Home Furnishing PTE Limited"
        po.currency = "FJD"
        po.transaction_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
        po.schedule_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()

        if doc.get("applicant"):
            if doc.get("applicant_type") != "Customer":
                frappe.throw("PO applicant must be a Customer.")

                frappe.throw("Customer not found: " + doc.applicant)

            po.customer = doc.applicant
            po.customer_name = doc.get("applicant_name")

        po.remarks = (
            "Loan Application: " + doc.name
            + " | Loan: " + str(loan_name)
            + " | Customer: " + str(doc.get("applicant_name") or "")
        )

        for row in items:
            description = row.get("product_description") or ""
            qty = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("quantity"))
            rate = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("unit_price"))

            if not description.strip():
                frappe.throw(
                    "Enter product description in HP row " + str(row.idx)
                )

            if qty <= 0:
                frappe.throw(
                    "Quantity must be greater than zero in HP row "
                    + str(row.idx)
                )

            po.append("items", {
                "item_code": "HP Product",
                "item_name": "General",

                "qty": qty,
                "rate": rate,
                "uom": "Unit",
                "stock_uom": "Unit",
                "conversion_factor": 1,
                "schedule_date": po.schedule_date
            })

        po.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        frappe.msgprint(
            "Draft Purchase Order " + po.name + " created.",
            title="LPO Generated",
            indicator="green"
        )

name: Flexi Default Customer Agreements
FLEXI DOCUMENT CUSTOMER SIGN
script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")
rowname = frappe.form_dict.get("rowname")
signature = frappe.form_dict.get("signature") or ""
signature_file = frappe.form_dict.get("signature_file") or ""
acknowledged = frappe.form_dict.get("acknowledged")
witness_name = frappe.form_dict.get("witness_name") or ""
witness_address = frappe.form_dict.get("witness_address") or ""
witness_signature = frappe.form_dict.get("witness_signature") or ""
witness_date = frappe.form_dict.get("witness_date") or frappe.utils.today()
hp_reference_no = frappe.form_dict.get("hp_reference_no")

if not docname or not rowname:
    frappe.throw("Loan Application and agreement row are required")

row = frappe.get_doc("Loan Customer Agreement", rowname)
if row.parent != docname or row.parenttype != "Loan Application":
    frappe.throw("This document does not belong to the selected Loan Application.")
if row.status == "Completed":
    frappe.throw("This agreement is already completed. Signed copies are not overwritten.")

template = frappe.get_doc("Loan Document Template", row.document_template)
if template.requires_acknowledgement and not acknowledged:
    frappe.throw("Customer acknowledgement is required.")

# The HP reference is a back-office/customer-signing input. Save it on the
# Loan Application before rendering so the signed agreement contains exactly
# the reference entered in the signing window.
if template.document_code == "HP-AGREEMENT" and hp_reference_no is not None:
    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Loan Application",
        docname,
        "custom_flexi_quotation_number",
        hp_reference_no.strip(),
        update_modified=False
    )

signature_value = signature or signature_file
if template.requires_signature and not signature_value:
    frappe.throw("Customer signature is required.")

if template.document_code == "FORM-1":
    if not witness_name or not witness_address or not witness_signature:
        frappe.throw("Witness name, address and signature are required for the Information Statement.")
    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Loan Application",
        docname,
        {
            "custom_witness_name": witness_name,
            "custom_witness_address": witness_address,
            "custom_witness_signature": witness_signature,
            "custom_witness_date": witness_date,
            "custom_flexi_form1_customer_date": frappe.utils.today()
        },
        update_modified=False
    )

rows = frappe.get_all(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    filters={"parent": docname, "parentfield": "custom_customer_documents"},
    fields=["name", "idx", "status"],
    order_by="idx asc"
)
# Customer documents may be signed in any order.

signed_on = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
values = {
    "customer_viewed": 1,
    "customer_viewed_on": row.customer_viewed_on or signed_on,
    "customer_acknowledged": 1,
    "customer_acknowledged_on": signed_on,
    "customer_signed_on": signed_on,
    "customer_signature": signature_value,
    "customer_signature_file": signature_file,
    "status": "Customer Signed" if template.requires_director_signature else "Completed"
}
if not template.requires_director_signature:
    values["completed_on"] = signed_on
frappe.db.set_value("Loan Customer Agreement", rowname, values, update_modified=False)

doc = frappe.get_doc("Loan Application", docname)
doc.hp_account_no = doc.custom_flexi_hp_account_number or doc.name
doc.hp_reference_no = doc.custom_flexi_quotation_number or ""
doc.hirer_signature = signature_value
doc.hirer_signature_date = signed_on
doc.custom_applicant_signature = signature_value
doc.company_representative_name = ""
doc.company_representative_signature = ""
doc.company_representative_date = None
doc.form2_date = doc.custom_flexi_form2_date or frappe.utils.today()
doc.form1_dated_at = doc.custom_flexi_form1_dated_at or frappe.utils.today()
doc.form1_this_location = doc.custom_flexi_form1_location or ""
doc.form1_customer_date = frappe.utils.today()

html = frappe.get_print("Loan Application", doc.name, print_format=template.print_format, doc=doc)
updates = {"generated_html": html, "generated_on": signed_on}

file_url = None
saved_as_pdf = 0
if not template.requires_director_signature:
    try:
        attached = frappe.attach_print(
            doc.doctype,
            doc.name,
            file_name=(template.document_name or template.document_code) + " - " + doc.name + " - SIGNED",
            print_format=template.print_format,
            html=html,
            doc=doc
        )
        file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "File",
            "file_name": attached["fname"],
            "content": attached["fcontent"],
            "is_private": 1,
            "attached_to_doctype": doc.doctype,
            "attached_to_name": doc.name
        })
        file_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        file_url = file_doc.file_url
        saved_as_pdf = 1 if attached["fname"].lower().endswith(".pdf") else 0
    except Exception:
        if ".localhost" not in frappe.get_url():
            raise
        fallback = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "File",
            "file_name": (template.document_name or template.document_code) + " - " + doc.name + " - SIGNED.html",
            "content": html.encode("utf-8"),
            "is_private": 1,
            "attached_to_doctype": doc.doctype,
            "attached_to_name": doc.name
        })
        fallback.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        file_url = fallback.file_url
    updates["final_signed_file"] = file_url

frappe.db.set_value("Loan Customer Agreement", rowname, updates, update_modified=False)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.flags.status = "Customer Signed" if template.requires_director_signature else "Completed"
frappe.flags.html = html
frappe.flags.file_url = file_url
frappe.flags.saved_as_pdf = saved_as_pdf
frappe.flags.requires_director_signature = template.requires_director_signature

script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")
rowname = frappe.form_dict.get("rowname")

director_signature = frappe.form_dict.get("director_signature") or ""
director_signature_file = frappe.form_dict.get("director_signature_file") or ""

if not docname or not rowname:
    frappe.throw("Loan Application and agreement row are required")

row = frappe.get_doc("Loan Customer Agreement", rowname)
if row.parent != docname or row.parenttype != "Loan Application":
    frappe.throw("This document does not belong to the selected Loan Application.")
if row.status == "Completed":
    frappe.throw("This agreement is already completed. Signed copies are not overwritten.")

template = frappe.get_doc("Loan Document Template", row.document_template)
if not template.requires_director_signature:
    frappe.throw("This document does not require a company signature.")
if row.status != "Customer Signed":
    frappe.throw("The customer must sign this document first.")

all_rows = frappe.get_all("Loan Customer Agreement", filters={"parent": docname, "parentfield": "custom_customer_documents"}, fields=["name", "status", "document_template"])
for agreement in all_rows:

signed_on = frappe.utils.now_datetime()

)

doc.hirer_signature_date = row.customer_signed_on

doc.form2_date = doc.custom_flexi_form2_date or frappe.utils.today()
doc.form1_dated_at = doc.custom_flexi_form1_dated_at or frappe.utils.today()
doc.form1_this_location = doc.custom_flexi_form1_location or ""
doc.form1_customer_date = doc.custom_flexi_form1_customer_date or frappe.utils.today()

company_addresses = frappe.get_all(
    "Address",
    filters={"is_your_company_address": 1},
    fields=["address_line1", "address_line2", "city", "state", "country"],
    limit_page_length=1
)
doc.company_registered_office = ", ".join(
    str(value) for value in company_addresses[0].values() if value
) if company_addresses else ""

html = frappe.get_print("Loan Application", doc.name, print_format=template.print_format, doc=doc)
if not html:
    frappe.throw("Final signed document could not be rendered.")

file_url = None
saved_as_pdf = 0
try:
    attached = frappe.attach_print(
        doc.doctype,
        doc.name,
        file_name=(template.document_name or template.document_code) + " - " + doc.name + " - SIGNED",
        print_format=template.print_format,
        html=html,
        doc=doc
    )
    file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "File",
        "file_name": attached["fname"],
        "content": attached["fcontent"],
        "is_private": 1,
        "attached_to_doctype": doc.doctype,
        "attached_to_name": doc.name
    })
    file_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    file_url = file_doc.file_url
    saved_as_pdf = 1 if attached["fname"].lower().endswith(".pdf") else 0
except Exception:
    if ".localhost" not in frappe.get_url():
        raise
    fallback = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "File",
        "file_name": (template.document_name or template.document_code) + " - " + doc.name + " - SIGNED.html",
        "content": html.encode("utf-8"),
        "is_private": 1,
        "attached_to_doctype": doc.doctype,
        "attached_to_name": doc.name
    })
    fallback.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    file_url = fallback.file_url

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    rowname,
    {
        "generated_html": html,
        "final_signed_file": file_url,
        "director_signed_on": signed_on,
        "completed_on": signed_on,
        "status": "Completed"
    },
    update_modified=False
)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.flags.status = "Completed"
frappe.flags.html = html
frappe.flags.file_url = file_url
frappe.flags.saved_as_pdf = saved_as_pdf
frappe.flags.document_name = template.document_name

name: FLEXI DOCUMENT SYNC
script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")

if not docname:
    frappe.throw("Loan Application is required")

if not frappe.db.exists("Loan Application", docname):
    frappe.throw("Loan Application was not found")

templates = frappe.get_all(
    "Loan Document Template",
    filters={"status": "Current", "document_code": ("!=", "REQ")},
    fields=["name", "document_code", "version", "sequence"],
    order_by="sequence asc"
)

existing_rows = frappe.get_all(
    "Loan Customer Agreement",
    filters={
        "parent": docname,
        "parenttype": "Loan Application",
        "parentfield": "custom_customer_documents"
    },
    fields=["name", "document_template", "document_code", "idx"],
    order_by="idx asc"
)

existing_templates = []
next_idx = 1
for existing in existing_rows:
    if existing.document_template:
        existing_templates.append(existing.document_template)
    if existing.idx and existing.idx >= next_idx:
        next_idx = existing.idx + 1
    if existing.document_template and not existing.document_code:
        code = frappe.db.get_value("Loan Document Template", existing.document_template, "document_code")
        if code:
            frappe.db.set_value("Loan Customer Agreement", existing.name, "document_code", code, update_modified=False)

added = 0
for template in templates:
    if template.name not in existing_templates:
        child = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Loan Customer Agreement",
            "parent": docname,
            "parenttype": "Loan Application",
            "parentfield": "custom_customer_documents",
            "idx": next_idx,
            "document_template": template.name,
            "document_code": template.document_code,
            "version": template.version or 1,
            "status": "Pending"
        })
        child.db_insert()
        next_idx = next_idx + 1
        added = added + 1

if not frappe.db.get_value("Loan Application", docname, "custom_flexi_hp_account_number"):
    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Loan Application",
        docname,
        "custom_flexi_hp_account_number",
        docname,
        update_modified=False
    )

frappe.db.commit()
frappe.flags.added = added
